story.imageAlt: Kader Yurteri, owner of Ali Supermarkt GmbH, outside the shop in Flamatt
story.title: A new generation. A new vision.
paragraphs: Since May 2025, I have been running Ali Supermarkt GmbH with great passion and a clear vision: I want to show that an international supermarket can be modern, diverse and, at the same time, personal.

As a young and dynamic owner, my aim is to bring a breath of fresh air to the international food trade. In doing so, I combine the diversity of different cultures with a modern shopping experience, good quality and a personal connection with our customers.

As a family-run business, warmth, trust and respect are particularly important to us. We want everyone to feel welcome here – whether they’re looking for familiar products from their home country or want to discover new specialities from around the world.
I look forward to developing Ali Supermarkt GmbH together with my family and to welcoming you personally to our shop.

items.q: Where is there a halal supermarket in Flamatt?
items.a: Ali Supermarkt at Bernstrasse 25 in Flamatt is the local supermarket in Flamatt with a halal range and international specialities.

items.q: Where can I buy halal meat in Flamatt?
items.a: At our meat counter at Ali Supermarkt, you can buy fresh, halal-certified meat every day – beef, lamb, poultry and sausages – with personal advice included.

items.q: Is Ali Supermarkt open on Sundays?
items.a: Yes. We’re open on Sundays from 10:00 to 16:00 – even when other shops are closed.

items.q: Where can I find Turkish food in Flamatt?
items.a: At Ali Supermarkt, you’ll find a selection of Turkish and international specialities – from antipasti to salça and vine leaves.

items.q: Where can I buy fresh fruit and vegetables in Flamatt?
items.a: Our selection of fruit and vegetables at Ali Supermarkt in Flamatt is restocked fresh every day.

items.q: Does Ali Supermarkt stock international food?
items.a: Yes, our range extends from staple foods to international specialities from various cuisines and cultures.
Ali Supermarkt is located at Bernstrasse 25, 3175 Wünnewil-Flamatt, Switzerland.
Monday to Thursday 08:00–19:00, Friday 08:00–20:00, Saturday 08:00–16:00, Sunday 10:00–16:00.

items.q: Is there parking at Ali Supermarkt?
items.a: Yes. There are free parking spaces right by the shop at Bernstrasse 25 – so you can easily come by car.

items.q: How do I get to Ali Supermarkt by public transport?
items.a: Flamatt railway station is about 300 metres away, roughly a five-minute walk. From there, you can reach us via Bernstrasse.

items.q: Can I pre-order meat or larger quantities?
items.a: Yes. Speak to our team at the counter or message us in advance on WhatsApp at +41 79 648 30 72 – we’ll be happy to prepare your order. Goat and mutton are available to order.

items.q: Where does the beef at Ali Supermarkt come from?
items.a: We source our beef from Melka Group (MELKA Viande Sàrl) in Moudon, in the canton of Vaud, a Swiss supplier of halal meat. We’re happy to tell you about the origin of individual products at the counter.

items.q: Do you have dairy products such as cheese, yoghurt and ayran?
items.a: Yes. In the chilled section, you’ll find milk, butter, cream, yoghurt in various sizes, and cheeses ranging from soft cheese in brine to kaşar. Ayran and chilled desserts are also available.

items.q: Does Ali Supermarkt also stock frozen food?
items.a: Yes. In our freezers, you’ll find poultry and meat products, fish, frozen vegetables, as well as ready-to-bake pastry and baked goods such as börek and flatbread.

items.q: Can I also get cleaning and household products here?
items.a: Yes. As well as food, we stock laundry detergent, cleaning products, personal care items and household goods such as paper towels and bin bags – so you can do all your shopping in one place.
Ali Supermarkt is run by Kader Yurteri, the owner of Ali Supermarkt GmbH. The shop has been serving customers in Flamatt since May 2025 and is run as a family business.

obst-gemuese.description: Our selection of fruit and vegetables is restocked daily – for great flavour. From seasonal classics to fresh herbs.

body: Our fruit and vegetable section is the first thing you see when you visit us in Flamatt – and it’s restocked every day. What’s delivered in the morning is on the shelves the same day: tomatoes, peppers, aubergines, courgettes and onions for everyday cooking, plus salads and fresh herbs from the chilled section.

As well as classics such as apples, bananas and oranges, you’ll find melons, grapes, figs and citrus fruits – staples in many cuisines around the Mediterranean and the Middle East. Depending on the season, other varieties are added – ask our team what’s particularly good right now.

If you’re shopping for several days or for guests, you’ll find many varieties in larger packs and crates. Let us know if you need larger quantities for a celebration – we’ll be happy to put your order together.

internationale-spezialitaeten.description: Products from different cuisines and cultures under one roof – from antipasti to salça and vine leaves.

body: International specialities are the heart of our range. On the shelves, products from Turkish, Arabic, Balkan and Mediterranean cuisine sit side by side – from salça made from tomatoes and peppers to pickled vegetables and vine leaves, olives, olive oil and tahini.

In the spice section, you’ll find the blends you really need for dishes from these cuisines: mild and hot paprika, cumin, sumac, mint, thyme and ready-made spice mixes. There’s also tea in many varieties, Turkish coffee, and tinned food and antipasti for a quick meal.
Many of our customers come to us because they can find a particular product from their home country here. If something is missing, let us know – we’ll be happy to see if we can add it to our range.

grundnahrungsmittel.description: From pulses and rice to spices and oils – everything you need for everyday cooking.

body: We deliberately stock a wide range of staple foods so that you can do your weekly shop in one place. Rice in various varieties, fine and coarse bulgur, couscous, flour, semolina and sugar are on the shelves alongside pasta in many shapes.
Our pulses include chickpeas, white and red beans and various lentils – packaged and tinned. We also stock oils, vinegar and tinned goods for your store cupboard.
Many products are also available in large packs, such as sacks of rice and flour for families or for stocking up. This is worthwhile if you regularly cook for a lot of people.

body: Our drinks section ranges from a chilled bottle for on the go to a crate for at home. The fridges are stocked with mineral water, soft drinks, iced tea, energy drinks and fruit juices – well chilled and within easy reach.

On the shelves, you’ll also find drinks that aren’t available in every supermarket: ayran, malt drinks, fruit nectars and syrups, as well as a large selection of tea. Water and soft drinks are also available in six-packs and crates.
For parties and larger occasions, we’re happy to prepare an order for you. Simply get in touch in advance on WhatsApp or speak to us in the shop.

body: For when you’re feeling peckish, we stock a wide selection of sweet and savoury treats. As well as chocolate, biscuits and wafers, you’ll find oriental sweets such as halva and lokum, as well as spreads and honey.
Our selection of nuts, seeds and dried fruit is particularly popular – from salted and unsalted nuts, pistachios and sunflower seeds to dried apricots, dates and figs.
We also stock crisps and savoury snacks, and there are changing offers on our promotion island in the middle of the shop. We’re happy to advise you in person on gifts for hosts and pastry platters.

milchprodukte.title: Dairy products
milchprodukte.description: Yoghurt, cheese, butter and milk – a wide selection of dairy products, well chilled and restocked daily.
slides: Chilled shelf with yoghurt, cheese and dairy products at Ali Supermarkt in Flamatt

body: In the chilled section, you’ll find dairy products for everyday needs and for international cooking. As well as milk, butter and cream, we stock yoghurt in various sizes – from single pots to family-size tubs.
Our cheeses range from soft cheese in brine and kaşar to grated cheese for börek and bakes. There’s also ayran, cream and chilled desserts.
All products are kept well chilled and restocked continuously – even on Sundays, if you need something at short notice.

tiefkuehlprodukte.description: In our freezers, you’ll find poultry, fish, meat products and more – handy for stocking up at home.

body: In our freezers, you’ll find everything that keeps well in stock. As well as poultry and meat products, we stock fish and seafood and frozen vegetables.
The ready-to-bake pastry and baked goods are popular: börek, filo pastry, mantı and flatbread, which you simply finish off at home. There are also ready meals and chips.
If you need larger quantities for a party or for your freezer at home, speak to our team – we’ll be happy to help you put your order together.

reinigung-haushalt.title: Cleaning & household
reinigung-haushalt.description: Laundry detergent, cleaning products and household supplies – so you can find everything for everyday life in one place.
slides: Shelf with laundry detergent and cleaning products at Ali Supermarkt in Flamatt
Shelf with cleaning products and household items
Aisle with cleaning products and personal care
body: So that you don’t have to go to a second shop for every little thing, we also stock everything for the home and cleaning. On the shelves you’ll find laundry detergent and fabric softener, washing-up liquid and cleaning products, as well as cleaners for the kitchen and bathroom.
There are also everyday personal care products such as soap, shampoo and toothpaste, and household items: paper towels, bin bags, aluminium foil and sponges.
Many items are also available in larger packs – handy for families and for anyone who doesn’t want to restock every week.
